tips.summary: VELVET MONARCH (1) has been racing in stronger grades and his last-start fourth at Caulfield behind two Group winners reads well for this. Drawn to get cover and should be too classy. RAPID VERDICT (8) is the improver, three wins from four this prep and the blinkers go on. HARBOUR LIGHTS (2) will roll forward from the wide gate and is hard to run down on the Flemington straight. LUNAR SOVEREIGN (4) is the knockout chance at odds.
